findings.note: With Nolan Traore out 8-10 weeks with a hamstring injury, Brown started Monday at Minnesota with his minutes restriction lifted and had 17 points and a career-high 7 assists in 29 minutes.
The NBA.com fantasy rookie rankings expect Brown to handle the ball more as long as Brooklyn keeps starting him, and say the Nets drafted him for his playmaking.
Brown averages 3.8 APG. His last five games had 7, 0, 4, 5 and 2 assists, with 3 of 5 over 3.5, though the lower games came off the bench on limited minutes (18-27 min).
